    • 字段详细资料

      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • endTime

        @NameInMap(value="EndTime")
public String endTime

        The end time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

        The interval between the start time and the end time must be greater than the monitoring frequency of the instance. Otherwise, an empty list may be returned.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        2012-06-18T15:00Z

      • key

        @NameInMap(value="Key")
public String key

        The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 metrics. For more information, see Performance metrics.

        If Key is set to MySQL_SpaceUsage or SQLServer_SpaceUsage, you can query only the monitoring data collected within the last 24 hours.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        MySQL_NetworkTraffic

      • nodeId

        @NameInMap(value="NodeId")
public String nodeId

        The unique identifier of the instance.

        example:

        339****

      • resourceOwnerId

        @NameInMap(value="ResourceOwnerId")
public Long resourceOwnerId

      • startTime

        @NameInMap(value="StartTime")
public String startTime

        The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

        The interval between the start time and the end time must be greater than the monitoring frequency of the instance. Otherwise, an empty list may be returned.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        2012-06-08T15:00Z
